imageUploadFromUrl.name: imageUploadFromUrl
imageUploadFromUrl.desc: Upload an image from an URL to Linear.

importFileUpload.name: importFileUpload
importFileUpload.desc: XHR request payload to upload a file for import, directly to Linear's cloud storage.

initiativeAddLabel.name: initiativeAddLabel
initiativeAddLabel.desc: Adds a label to an initiative.

initiativeLabelRestore.name: initiativeLabelRestore
initiativeLabelRestore.desc: Restores a previously retired initiative label, making it available for use on new initiatives.

initiativeLabelRetire.name: initiativeLabelRetire
initiativeLabelRetire.desc: Retires an initiative label. Retired labels remain on existing initiatives but cannot be applied to new ones.

initiativeLeadTeamUpdate.name: initiativeLeadTeamUpdate
initiativeLeadTeamUpdate.desc: [Internal] Updates an initiative's lead team, optionally applying it to matching editable sub-initiatives.

initiativeRelationCreate.name: initiativeRelationCreate
initiativeRelationCreate.desc: Creates a new parent-child relation between two initiatives. The relation cannot create cycles or exceed maximum nesting depth.

initiativeRemoveLabel.name: initiativeRemoveLabel
initiativeRemoveLabel.desc: Removes a label from an initiative.

initiativeToProjectCreate.name: initiativeToProjectCreate
initiativeToProjectCreate.desc: Associates a project with an initiative. A project can only appear once in an initiative hierarchy.

initiativeToProjectDelete.name: initiativeToProjectDelete
initiativeToProjectDelete.desc: Removes a project from an initiative.

initiativeToProjectUpdate.name: initiativeToProjectUpdate
initiativeToProjectUpdate.desc: Updates an initiative-to-project association, such as its sort order.

integrationAsksConnectChannel.name: integrationAsksConnectChannel
integrationAsksConnectChannel.desc: Connect a Slack channel to Asks.

integrationCustomerDataAttributesRefresh.name: integrationCustomerDataAttributesRefresh
integrationCustomerDataAttributesRefresh.desc: [INTERNAL] Refreshes the customer data attributes from the specified integration service.

integrationGitHubEnterpriseServerConnect.name: integrationGitHubEnterpriseServerConnect
integrationGitHubEnterpriseServerConnect.desc: Connects the workspace with a GitHub Enterprise Server.

integrationGitHubPersonal.name: integrationGitHubPersonal
integrationGitHubPersonal.desc: Connect your GitHub account to Linear.

integrationGithubCommitCreate.name: integrationGithubCommitCreate
integrationGithubCommitCreate.desc: Generates a webhook for the GitHub commit integration.

integrationGithubConnect.name: integrationGithubConnect
integrationGithubConnect.desc: Connects the workspace with the GitHub App.

integrationGithubImportConnect.name: integrationGithubImportConnect
integrationGithubImportConnect.desc: Connects the workspace with the GitHub Import App.

integrationGithubImportRefresh.name: integrationGithubImportRefresh
integrationGithubImportRefresh.desc: Refreshes the data for a GitHub import integration.

integrationGithubRemoveCodeAccess.name: integrationGithubRemoveCodeAccess
integrationGithubRemoveCodeAccess.desc: Removes code access from a GitHub integration, downgrading to the basic GitHub App.

integrationGitlabConnect.name: integrationGitlabConnect
integrationGitlabConnect.desc: Connects the workspace with a GitLab Access Token.

integrationGitlabTestConnection.name: integrationGitlabTestConnection
integrationGitlabTestConnection.desc: Tests connectivity to a self-hosted GitLab instance and clears auth errors if successful.

integrationGoogleCalendarPersonalConnect.name: integrationGoogleCalendarPersonalConnect
integrationGoogleCalendarPersonalConnect.desc: [Internal] Connects the Google Calendar to the user to this Linear account via OAuth2.

integrationGoogleSheets.name: integrationGoogleSheets
integrationGoogleSheets.desc: Integrates the workspace with Google Sheets.

integrationIntercomSettingsUpdate.name: integrationIntercomSettingsUpdate
integrationIntercomSettingsUpdate.desc: [DEPRECATED] Updates settings on the Intercom integration.

integrationJiraFetchProjectStatuses.name: integrationJiraFetchProjectStatuses
integrationJiraFetchProjectStatuses.desc: [INTERNAL] Fetches Jira project statuses and stores them in integration settings.

integrationJiraPersonal.name: integrationJiraPersonal
integrationJiraPersonal.desc: Connect your Jira account to Linear.

integrationLaunchDarklyPersonalConnect.name: integrationLaunchDarklyPersonalConnect
integrationLaunchDarklyPersonalConnect.desc: [INTERNAL] Integrates your personal account with LaunchDarkly.

integrationLoom.name: integrationLoom
integrationLoom.desc: Enables Loom integration for the workspace.

integrationMcpServerConnect.name: integrationMcpServerConnect
integrationMcpServerConnect.desc: [INTERNAL] Connects the workspace with an MCP server.

integrationMcpServerPersonalConnect.name: integrationMcpServerPersonalConnect
integrationMcpServerPersonalConnect.desc: [INTERNAL] Connects the user's personal account with an MCP server.

integrationMicrosoftPersonalConnect.name: integrationMicrosoftPersonalConnect
integrationMicrosoftPersonalConnect.desc: Connects the user's personal Microsoft account to Linear.

integrationMicrosoftTeams.name: integrationMicrosoftTeams
integrationMicrosoftTeams.desc: Integrates the workspace with Microsoft Teams.

integrationMicrosoftTeamsProjectPost.name: integrationMicrosoftTeamsProjectPost
integrationMicrosoftTeamsProjectPost.desc: [Internal] Connect a project to a Microsoft Teams channel. Find-or-update semantics: creates a microsoftTeamsProjectPost integration row if none exists for the project, or overwrites the existing one's team/channel selection. Requires the connecting user to have linked their personal Microsoft account.

integrationSlackAsks.name: integrationSlackAsks
integrationSlackAsks.desc: Integrates the workspace with the Slack Asks app.

integrationSlackCustomViewNotifications.name: integrationSlackCustomViewNotifications
integrationSlackCustomViewNotifications.desc: Slack integration for custom view notifications.

integrationSlackCustomerChannelLink.name: integrationSlackCustomerChannelLink
integrationSlackCustomerChannelLink.desc: Integrates a Slack Asks channel with a Customer.

integrationSlackImportEmojis.name: integrationSlackImportEmojis
integrationSlackImportEmojis.desc: Imports custom emojis from your Slack workspace.

integrationSlackOrAsksUpdateSlackTeamNam.name: integrationSlackOrAsksUpdateSlackTeamName
integrationSlackOrAsksUpdateSlackTeamNam.desc: Updates the Slack team's name in Linear for an existing Slack or Asks integration.

integrationSlackOrgInitiativeUpdatesPost.name: integrationSlackOrgInitiativeUpdatesPost
integrationSlackOrgInitiativeUpdatesPost.desc: [Internal] Slack integration for workspace-level initiative update notifications.

integrationSlackOrgProjectUpdatesPost.name: integrationSlackOrgProjectUpdatesPost
integrationSlackOrgProjectUpdatesPost.desc: Slack integration for workspace-level project update notifications.

integrationSlackPersonal.name: integrationSlackPersonal
integrationSlackPersonal.desc: Integrates your personal notifications with Slack.

integrationSlackWorkflowAccessUpdate.name: integrationSlackWorkflowAccessUpdate
integrationSlackWorkflowAccessUpdate.desc: [Internal] Enables Linear Agent Slack workflow access for a Slack or Slack Asks integration.

integrationTemplateCreate.name: integrationTemplateCreate
integrationTemplateCreate.desc: Creates a new connection between a template and an integration, optionally scoped to a specific external resource such as a Slack channel.

integrationTemplateDelete.name: integrationTemplateDelete
integrationTemplateDelete.desc: Deletes an integration template connection, removing the link between a template and an integration.

integrationsSettingsCreate.name: integrationsSettingsCreate
integrationsSettingsCreate.desc: Creates new Slack notification settings for a team, project, initiative, or custom view.

integrationsSettingsUpdate.name: integrationsSettingsUpdate
integrationsSettingsUpdate.desc: Updates Slack notification settings for a team, project, initiative, or custom view.

issueAddLabel.name: issueAddLabel
issueAddLabel.desc: Adds a label to an issue.

issueBatchCreate.name: issueBatchCreate
issueBatchCreate.desc: Creates a list of issues in one transaction.

issueDescriptionUpdateFromFront.name: issueDescriptionUpdateFromFront
issueDescriptionUpdateFromFront.desc: [INTERNAL] Updates an issue description from the Front app to handle Front attachments correctly.

issueExternalSyncDisable.name: issueExternalSyncDisable
issueExternalSyncDisable.desc: Disables external sync on an issue.

issueImportCreateAsana.name: issueImportCreateAsana
issueImportCreateAsana.desc: Kicks off an Asana import job.

issueImportCreateCSVJira.name: issueImportCreateCSVJira
issueImportCreateCSVJira.desc: Kicks off a Jira import job from a CSV.

issueImportCreateClubhouse.name: issueImportCreateClubhouse
issueImportCreateClubhouse.desc: Kicks off a Shortcut (formerly Clubhouse) import job.

issueImportCreateGithub.name: issueImportCreateGithub
issueImportCreateGithub.desc: Kicks off a GitHub import job.

issueImportCreateJira.name: issueImportCreateJira
issueImportCreateJira.desc: Kicks off a Jira import job.

issueImportCreateLinearV2.name: issueImportCreateLinearV2
issueImportCreateLinearV2.desc: [INTERNAL] Kicks off a Linear to Linear import job.

issueImportUpdate.name: issueImportUpdate
issueImportUpdate.desc: Updates the mapping for the issue import.

issueLabelRestore.name: issueLabelRestore
issueLabelRestore.desc: Restores a previously retired label, making it available for use again.

issueLabelRetire.name: issueLabelRetire
issueLabelRetire.desc: Retires a label. Retired labels are still visible but cannot be applied to new issues. Existing issues with the label are not affected.

issueReminder.name: issueReminder
issueReminder.desc: Adds an issue reminder. Will cause a notification to be sent when the issue reminder time is reached.

issueRemoveLabel.name: issueRemoveLabel
issueRemoveLabel.desc: Removes a label from an issue.

issueShare.name: issueShare
issueShare.desc: Shares an issue with a user who would not otherwise be able to access it. The viewer must have native access to the issue's full sub-issue tree and permission to share issues in the issue's team. Issues that inherit sharing from a parent issue cannot be shared directly.

issueSubscribe.name: issueSubscribe
issueSubscribe.desc: Subscribes a user to an issue.

issueToReleaseCreate.name: issueToReleaseCreate
issueToReleaseCreate.desc: Creates a new association between an issue and a release, linking the issue to the release for tracking purposes.

issueToReleaseDelete.name: issueToReleaseDelete
issueToReleaseDelete.desc: Deletes an issue-to-release association by its identifier, removing the issue from the release.

issueToReleaseDeleteByIssueAndRelease.name: issueToReleaseDeleteByIssueAndRelease
issueToReleaseDeleteByIssueAndRelease.desc: Deletes an issue-to-release association by looking up the issue and release identifiers, removing the issue from the release.

issueUnshare.name: issueUnshare
issueUnshare.desc: Stops sharing an issue with a user. The viewer must have native access to the issue's full sub-issue tree and permission to share issues in the issue's team. Issues that inherit sharing from a parent issue cannot be unshared directly.

issueUnsubscribe.name: issueUnsubscribe
issueUnsubscribe.desc: Unsubscribes a user from an issue.

jiraIntegrationConnect.name: jiraIntegrationConnect
jiraIntegrationConnect.desc: [INTERNAL] Connects the workspace with a Jira Personal Access Token.

logoutAllSessions.name: logoutAllSessions
logoutAllSessions.desc: Logout all of user's sessions including the active one.

logoutOtherSessions.name: logoutOtherSessions
logoutOtherSessions.desc: Logout all of user's sessions excluding the current one.

logoutSession.name: logoutSession
logoutSession.desc: Logout an individual session with its ID.

notificationArchiveAll.name: notificationArchiveAll
notificationArchiveAll.desc: Archives a notification and all related notifications.

notificationCategoryChannelSubscriptionU.name: notificationCategoryChannelSubscriptionUpdate
notificationCategoryChannelSubscriptionU.desc: Subscribes to or unsubscribes from a specific notification category for a given notification channel. For example, subscribe to 'issueAssignment' notifications via the 'email' channel.

notificationMarkReadAll.name: notificationMarkReadAll
notificationMarkReadAll.desc: Marks notification and all related notifications as read.

notificationMarkUnreadAll.name: notificationMarkUnreadAll
notificationMarkUnreadAll.desc: Marks notification and all related notifications as unread.

notificationSnoozeAll.name: notificationSnoozeAll
notificationSnoozeAll.desc: Snoozes a notification and all related notifications.

notificationSubscriptionCreate.name: notificationSubscriptionCreate
notificationSubscriptionCreate.desc: Creates a new notification subscription for a specific entity. The subscription determines which notification types the authenticated user will receive for the target entity. Exactly one target entity (customer, custom view, cycle, initiative, label, project, team, or user) must be specified.

notificationUnsnoozeAll.name: notificationUnsnoozeAll
notificationUnsnoozeAll.desc: Unsnoozes a notification and all related notifications.

oauthApplicationArchive.name: oauthApplicationArchive
oauthApplicationArchive.desc: [ALPHA] Archives an OAuth application created by the calling OAuth application.

oauthApplicationCreate.name: oauthApplicationCreate
oauthApplicationCreate.desc: [ALPHA] Creates an OAuth application owned by the calling OAuth application.

oauthApplicationRotateSecret.name: oauthApplicationRotateSecret
oauthApplicationRotateSecret.desc: [ALPHA] Rotates the client secret for an OAuth application created by the calling OAuth application.

oauthApplicationRotateWebhookSecret.name: oauthApplicationRotateWebhookSecret
oauthApplicationRotateWebhookSecret.desc: [ALPHA] Rotates the webhook signing secret for an OAuth application created by the calling OAuth application.

oauthApplicationUpdate.name: oauthApplicationUpdate
oauthApplicationUpdate.desc: [ALPHA] Updates an OAuth application created by the calling OAuth application.

organizationCancelDelete.name: organizationCancelDelete
organizationCancelDelete.desc: Cancels a previously requested workspace deletion, if the workspace has not yet been fully deleted.

organizationDelete.name: organizationDelete
organizationDelete.desc: Permanently deletes the workspace and all its data. Requires a valid deletion code obtained from organizationDeleteChallenge. This action is irreversible.

organizationDeleteChallenge.name: organizationDeleteChallenge
organizationDeleteChallenge.desc: Requests a deletion confirmation code for the workspace. The code is sent to the requesting user's email and must be used with the organizationDelete mutation to confirm deletion.

organizationDomainCreate.name: organizationDomainCreate
organizationDomainCreate.desc: [INTERNAL] Adds a domain to be allowed for a workspace.

organizationDomainVerify.name: organizationDomainVerify
organizationDomainVerify.desc: [INTERNAL] Verifies a domain to be added to a workspace.

organizationInviteCreate.name: organizationInviteCreate
organizationInviteCreate.desc: Creates a new workspace invite and sends an invitation email to the specified address. The invite includes a role assignment and optional team memberships.

organizationInviteDelete.name: organizationInviteDelete
organizationInviteDelete.desc: Deletes (archives) a workspace invite, preventing it from being accepted.

organizationInviteUpdate.name: organizationInviteUpdate
organizationInviteUpdate.desc: Updates an existing workspace invite, such as changing the teams the invitee will be added to.

organizationStartTrial.name: organizationStartTrial
organizationStartTrial.desc: [DEPRECATED] Starts a trial for the workspace.

organizationStartTrialForPlan.name: organizationStartTrialForPlan
organizationStartTrialForPlan.desc: Starts a trial for the workspace on the specified plan type. The workspace must not already be on a paid plan or in an active trial.

organizationUpdate.name: organizationUpdate
organizationUpdate.desc: Updates the user's workspace settings. Different settings require different permission levels; most require the workspaceSettings admin permission.

partnerApplicationCreate.name: partnerApplicationCreate
partnerApplicationCreate.desc: [INTERNAL] Submits a Startup Program partner application from the website, creating a triage issue for the startup team.

partnerOfferRedeem.name: partnerOfferRedeem
partnerOfferRedeem.desc: [Internal] Redeems a partner-offer token for one of the viewer's existing workspaces, recording a pending redemption that is applied when the workspace subscribes. Requires an admin or owner role in the workspace.

projectAddLabel.name: projectAddLabel
projectAddLabel.desc: Adds a label to a project.

projectCreateSlackChannel.name: projectCreateSlackChannel
projectCreateSlackChannel.desc: [Internal] Creates a Slack channel for an existing project.

projectDelete.name: projectDelete
projectDelete.desc: Deletes (trashes) a project. The project can be restored later with projectUnarchive.

projectDismissSlackChannelCreationFailur.name: projectDismissSlackChannelCreationFailure
projectDismissSlackChannelCreationFailur.desc: [Internal] Dismisses the Slack channel creation failure notice for a project.

projectExternalSyncDisable.name: projectExternalSyncDisable
projectExternalSyncDisable.desc: Disables external sync on a project.

projectLabelRestore.name: projectLabelRestore
projectLabelRestore.desc: Restores a previously retired project label, making it available for use on new projects.

projectLabelRetire.name: projectLabelRetire
projectLabelRetire.desc: Retires a project label. Retired labels remain on existing projects but cannot be applied to new ones.

projectMilestoneMove.name: projectMilestoneMove
projectMilestoneMove.desc: [Internal] Moves a project milestone to another project, can be called to undo a prior move.

projectReassignStatus.name: projectReassignStatus
projectReassignStatus.desc: [INTERNAL] Reassigns all projects from one project status to another. Used when archiving or deleting a project status.

projectRemoveLabel.name: projectRemoveLabel
projectRemoveLabel.desc: Removes a label from a project.

projectStatusArchive.name: projectStatusArchive
projectStatusArchive.desc: Archives a project status. The status must not have any active projects assigned to it and must not be the last status of its type.

projectUnarchive.name: projectUnarchive
projectUnarchive.desc: Restores a previously trashed or archived project.

pushSubscriptionCreate.name: pushSubscriptionCreate
pushSubscriptionCreate.desc: Creates a push subscription for the authenticated user's current device or browser. If a subscription already exists for the same session, the old one is replaced.

pushSubscriptionDelete.name: pushSubscriptionDelete
pushSubscriptionDelete.desc: Deletes a push subscription, unregistering the device from receiving push notifications.

releaseComplete.name: releaseComplete
releaseComplete.desc: Marks a release as completed. If version is provided, completes that specific release; otherwise completes the most recent started release.

releaseCompleteByAccessKey.name: releaseCompleteByAccessKey
releaseCompleteByAccessKey.desc: Marks a release as completed using an access key. If version is provided, completes that specific release; otherwise completes the most recent started release. The pipeline is inferred from the access key.

releaseCreate.name: releaseCreate
releaseCreate.desc: Creates a new release in a pipeline. If no stage is specified, defaults to the first completed stage for continuous pipelines or the first started stage for scheduled pipelines.

releaseDelete.name: releaseDelete
releaseDelete.desc: Moves a release to the trash bin. Trashed releases are archived and will be permanently deleted after a retention period. If the release is already archived, it is marked as trashed with a fresh archive timestamp.

releasePipelineCreate.name: releasePipelineCreate
releasePipelineCreate.desc: Creates a new release pipeline with default stages. Subject to plan entitlement and quota limits.

releasePipelineDelete.name: releasePipelineDelete
releasePipelineDelete.desc: Moves a release pipeline to the trash bin. Trashed pipelines are archived and will be permanently deleted after a retention period, along with all their releases. If the pipeline is already archived, it is marked as trashed with a fresh archive timestamp.

releasePipelineUpdate.name: releasePipelineUpdate
releasePipelineUpdate.desc: Updates an existing release pipeline. Supports updating name, slug, type, production flag, path patterns, and team associations. Private teams that the current user cannot access are preserved in the team list.

releaseStageArchive.name: releaseStageArchive
releaseStageArchive.desc: Archives a release stage. Only started-type stages can be archived, and only if they have no active releases and at least one other stage of the same type remains. Cannot archive the last non-frozen started stage.

releaseStageCreate.name: releaseStageCreate
releaseStageCreate.desc: Creates a new release stage in a pipeline. Non-started stages must use default names and colors and are unique by type; creating a canonical duplicate returns the existing stage. Started stages can optionally be frozen, but at least one non-frozen started stage must remain.

releaseStageUpdate.name: releaseStageUpdate
releaseStageUpdate.desc: Updates an existing release stage. Only started-type stages can be edited. Supports updating name, color, position, and frozen status.

releaseSync.name: releaseSync
releaseSync.desc: Syncs release data by resolving issue and pull request references and associating them with a release. For continuous pipelines, creates a new completed release. For scheduled pipelines, finds or creates a started release and accumulates issues into it.

releaseSyncByAccessKey.name: releaseSyncByAccessKey
releaseSyncByAccessKey.desc: Syncs release data using an access key for CI/CD integration. The pipeline is automatically inferred from the access key's configured resources, so no pipeline ID is needed in the input.

releaseUpdate.name: releaseUpdate
releaseUpdate.desc: Updates an existing release by ID. Supports updating name, description, version, commit SHA, pipeline, stage, and dates.

releaseUpdateByPipeline.name: releaseUpdateByPipeline
releaseUpdateByPipeline.desc: Updates a release by pipeline identifier. Finds the release by version or latest started/planned release, and optionally transitions it to a new stage by name.

releaseUpdateByPipelineByAccessKey.name: releaseUpdateByPipelineByAccessKey
releaseUpdateByPipelineByAccessKey.desc: Updates a release by pipeline using an access key.

resendOrganizationInvite.name: resendOrganizationInvite
resendOrganizationInvite.desc: Re-sends a workspace invitation email for the specified invite ID.

resendOrganizationInviteByEmail.name: resendOrganizationInviteByEmail
resendOrganizationInviteByEmail.desc: Re-sends a workspace invitation email to the specified email address, if an outstanding invite exists for that address.

roadmapToProjectCreate.name: roadmapToProjectCreate
roadmapToProjectCreate.desc: [Deprecated] Creates a new roadmap-to-project association. Use InitiativeToProject instead.

roadmapToProjectDelete.name: roadmapToProjectDelete
roadmapToProjectDelete.desc: [Deprecated] Deletes a roadmap-to-project association. Use InitiativeToProject instead.

roadmapToProjectUpdate.name: roadmapToProjectUpdate
roadmapToProjectUpdate.desc: [Deprecated] Updates a roadmap-to-project association. Use InitiativeToProject instead.

samlTokenUserAccountAuth.name: samlTokenUserAccountAuth
samlTokenUserAccountAuth.desc: Authenticates a user account via email and authentication token for SAML.

teamCreate.name: teamCreate
teamCreate.desc: Creates a new team. The user who creates the team will automatically be added as a member and owner of the newly created team. Default workflow states, labels, and other team resources are created alongside the team.

teamCyclesDelete.name: teamCyclesDelete
teamCyclesDelete.desc: Deletes all cycle data for a team, disabling the cycles feature. This removes all cycles and their issue associations.

teamDelete.name: teamDelete
teamDelete.desc: Archives a team and schedules its data for deletion. Requires team owner or workspace admin permissions.

teamKeyDelete.name: teamKeyDelete
teamKeyDelete.desc: Deletes a previously used team key. The active team key (the team's current key) cannot be deleted.

teamMembershipCreate.name: teamMembershipCreate
teamMembershipCreate.desc: Creates a new team membership, adding a user to a team. Validates that the user is not already a member, the team is not archived or retired, and the requesting user has permission to add members.

teamMembershipDelete.name: teamMembershipDelete
teamMembershipDelete.desc: Deletes a team membership, removing the user from the team. Users can remove their own membership, or team owners and workspace admins can remove other members.

teamMembershipUpdate.name: teamMembershipUpdate
teamMembershipUpdate.desc: Updates a team membership, such as changing ownership status or sort order.

teamUnarchive.name: teamUnarchive
teamUnarchive.desc: Unarchives a team and cancels deletion.

teamUpdate.name: teamUpdate
teamUpdate.desc: Updates a team's settings, properties, or configuration. Requires team owner or workspace admin permissions for most changes.

updateIntegrationSlackScopes.name: updateIntegrationSlackScopes
updateIntegrationSlackScopes.desc: [Internal] Updates existing Slack and Asks integration scopes.

userChangeRole.name: userChangeRole
userChangeRole.desc: Changes the workspace role of a user. The requesting user must have a role equal to or higher than the target role. Requires workspace admin permissions.

userDiscordConnect.name: userDiscordConnect
userDiscordConnect.desc: Connects the Discord user to this Linear account via OAuth2.

userExternalUserDisconnect.name: userExternalUserDisconnect
userExternalUserDisconnect.desc: Disconnects the external user from this Linear account.

userFlagUpdate.name: userFlagUpdate
userFlagUpdate.desc: Updates a specific user settings flag by performing an operation (e.g., increment or clear) on it.

userRevokeAllSessions.name: userRevokeAllSessions
userRevokeAllSessions.desc: Revokes all active sessions for a user, forcing them to re-authenticate. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

userRevokeSession.name: userRevokeSession
userRevokeSession.desc: Revokes a specific authentication session for a user. The admin cannot revoke their own sessions with this mutation. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

userSettingsFlagsReset.name: userSettingsFlagsReset
userSettingsFlagsReset.desc: Resets one or more of the user's setting flags. If no specific flags are provided, all flags are reset.

userSettingsUpdate.name: userSettingsUpdate
userSettingsUpdate.desc: Updates the authenticated user's settings, including notification preferences, email subscriptions, theme, and other UI preferences.

userSuspend.name: userSuspend
userSuspend.desc: Suspends a user, deactivating their account and revoking access to the workspace. The suspended user's sessions are invalidated. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

userUnlinkFromIdentityProvider.name: userUnlinkFromIdentityProvider
userUnlinkFromIdentityProvider.desc: Unlinks a guest user from their identity provider. Can only be called by an admin when SCIM is enabled.

userUnsuspend.name: userUnsuspend
userUnsuspend.desc: Re-activates a suspended user, restoring their access to the workspace. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

userUpdate.name: userUpdate
userUpdate.desc: Updates a user's profile information. Users can update their own profile; workspace admins can update any user's profile. SCIM-managed users may have restricted name changes.

viewPreferencesCreate.name: viewPreferencesCreate
viewPreferencesCreate.desc: Creates a new view preferences object. If conflicting preferences already exist for the same view type and scope, the existing preferences are replaced.

viewPreferencesDelete.name: viewPreferencesDelete
viewPreferencesDelete.desc: Deletes a view preferences object. If the preferences do not exist, the operation is treated as a successful idempotent deletion.

viewPreferencesUpdate.name: viewPreferencesUpdate
viewPreferencesUpdate.desc: Updates an existing view preferences object. For user-type preferences, only the owning user can update them.

webhookCreate.name: webhookCreate
webhookCreate.desc: Creates a new webhook subscription for the workspace. Requires specifying a URL, resource types to subscribe to, and either a specific team or all public teams.

webhookRotateSecret.name: webhookRotateSecret
webhookRotateSecret.desc: Rotates the signing secret for a webhook, generating a new HMAC-SHA256 key and returning it. The old secret is immediately invalidated.

workflowStateArchive.name: workflowStateArchive
workflowStateArchive.desc: Archives a state. Only states with issues that have all been archived can be archived.

workflowStateCreate.name: workflowStateCreate
workflowStateCreate.desc: Creates a new state, adding it to the workflow of a team.

agentActivityArchived.name: agentActivityArchived
agentActivityArchived.desc: Triggered when an agent activity is archived

agentActivityCreated.name: agentActivityCreated
agentActivityCreated.desc: Triggered when an agent activity is created

agentActivityUpdated.name: agentActivityUpdated
agentActivityUpdated.desc: Triggered when an agent activity is updated

agentSessionCreated.name: agentSessionCreated
agentSessionCreated.desc: Triggered when an agent session is created

agentSessionUpdated.name: agentSessionUpdated
agentSessionUpdated.desc: Triggered when an agent session is updated

aiConversationUpdated.desc: Triggered when an ai conversation is updated

aiPromptProgressCreated.name: aiPromptProgressCreated
aiPromptProgressCreated.desc: Triggered when an ai prompt progress is created

aiPromptProgressUpdated.name: aiPromptProgressUpdated
aiPromptProgressUpdated.desc: Triggered when an ai prompt progress is updated

commentArchived.name: commentArchived
commentArchived.desc: Triggered when a comment is archived

commentCreated.name: commentCreated
commentCreated.desc: Triggered when a comment is created

commentDeleted.name: commentDeleted
commentDeleted.desc: Triggered when a comment is deleted

commentUnarchived.name: commentUnarchived
commentUnarchived.desc: Triggered when a a comment is unarchived

commentUpdated.name: commentUpdated
commentUpdated.desc: Triggered when a comment is updated

cycleArchived.desc: Triggered when a cycle is archived

cycleCreated.name: cycleCreated
cycleCreated.desc: Triggered when a cycle is created

cycleUpdated.name: cycleUpdated
cycleUpdated.desc: Triggered when a cycle is updated

documentArchived.name: documentArchived
documentArchived.desc: Triggered when a document is archived

documentContentCreated.name: documentContentCreated
documentContentCreated.desc: Triggered when a document content is created

documentContentDraftCreated.name: documentContentDraftCreated
documentContentDraftCreated.desc: Triggered when a document content draft is created

documentContentDraftDeleted.name: documentContentDraftDeleted
documentContentDraftDeleted.desc: Triggered when a document content draft is deleted

documentContentDraftUpdated.name: documentContentDraftUpdated
documentContentDraftUpdated.desc: Triggered when a document content draft is updated

documentContentRevisionCreated.name: documentContentRevisionCreated
documentContentRevisionCreated.desc: Triggered when a document content revision is created

documentContentRevisionDeleted.name: documentContentRevisionDeleted
documentContentRevisionDeleted.desc: Triggered when a document content revision is deleted

documentContentRevisionUpdated.name: documentContentRevisionUpdated
documentContentRevisionUpdated.desc: Triggered when a document content revision is updated

documentContentUpdated.name: documentContentUpdated
documentContentUpdated.desc: Triggered when a document content is updated

documentCreated.name: documentCreated
documentCreated.desc: Triggered when a document is created

documentUnarchived.name: documentUnarchived
documentUnarchived.desc: Triggered when a a document is unarchived

documentUpdated.name: documentUpdated
documentUpdated.desc: Triggered when a document is updated

draftCreated.name: draftCreated
draftCreated.desc: Triggered when a draft is created

draftDeleted.name: draftDeleted
draftDeleted.desc: Triggered when a draft is deleted

draftUpdated.name: draftUpdated
draftUpdated.desc: Triggered when a draft is updated

favoriteCreated.name: favoriteCreated
favoriteCreated.desc: Triggered when a favorite is created

favoriteDeleted.name: favoriteDeleted
favoriteDeleted.desc: Triggered when a favorite is deleted

favoriteUpdated.name: favoriteUpdated
favoriteUpdated.desc: Triggered when a favorite is updated

initiativeCreated.name: initiativeCreated
initiativeCreated.desc: Triggered when an initiative is created

initiativeDeleted.name: initiativeDeleted
initiativeDeleted.desc: Triggered when an initiative is deleted

initiativeUpdated.name: initiativeUpdated
initiativeUpdated.desc: Triggered when an initiative is updated

issueArchived.name: issueArchived
issueArchived.desc: Triggered when an issue is archived

issueCreated.name: issueCreated
issueCreated.desc: Triggered when an issue is created

issueDraftCreated.name: issueDraftCreated
issueDraftCreated.desc: Triggered when an issue draft is created

issueDraftDeleted.name: issueDraftDeleted
